trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read: remark interpreting def:categorical-instanton. Math checked: the Bogomolny form ||F||^2 = c_2(A) + 2||F^-||^2 is the standard 4d decomposition ||F||^2 = ||F^+||^2 + ||F^-||^2 with c_2 ~ ||F^+||^2 - ||F^-||^2, so F^-=0 giving ||F||^2 = c_2 is correct. Cross-checked D_nabla^2 against def:categorical-lagrangian, which defines L_q = D_nabla^2 + psi^* (x) D_nabla psi with D_nabla^2 the bosonic summand -- so the on-shell L_q = c_2(A) + psi^* (x) D_nabla psi is consistent with the parent definition. Adjudicated 'All physics lies in the matter equation D_nabla psi = 0': 'all' here is a precise quantifier over the surviving dynamical content (the gauge summand is a constant), not unqualified emphasis, so it is not category-9 inflation. 'There are no dynamical gauge degrees of freedom beyond topology' is a substantive vanishing claim, not assertion-by-denial.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: No trap. Structural note (not a trap, not fixed): the block equates the endomorphism D_nabla^2 with the scalar ||F_nabla||^2 without stating the identification -- the Bogomolny line is written in ||.||^2 and the conclusion in D_nabla^2.
